title: What is Intel Optane (Official Dell Tech Support)
description: What is Intel Optane memory? Learn about this smart memory technology and how it can increase your computer’s hard drive responsiveness. This technology is designed for all kind of users, regardless of how you use your PC; for not only those who simply browse the web but up to professional power users as well.  If you have questions or need support, contact us through social media on Facebook at www.facebook.com/dell and Twitter at www.twitter.com/dellcares  You can also join in a chat on our Dell Community Forum at www.dell.com/community  and click on Support Forums. To learn more about our Dell Community Forum check out http://dell.to/2tbhVvt  For additional guidance with your PC's maintenance and troubleshooting visit http://dell.to/2te92S1

asr.full_text: Intel Optane Memory is a smart memory technology that accelerate the computers responsiveness. It is designed to increase your computer's hard drive speed . Intel Optane Memory remembers your frequently used documents, pictures, videos and apps after you power off your PC, enabling you to create, game and apps after you power off your PC enabling you to create game and produce with less waiting time the next time you go to use them. Intel Optane memory versus Ram what happens with DRAM dynamic random access memory is that when you power off your computer the content within DRAM is lost forever because DRAM only temporarily holds information that your processor performs. On the other hand Intel's Optane's Memory Smart Technology accesses what you frequently use in the system and remembers it all after you power off. Because it can do this, you get better overall system responsiveness far superior to adding additional DRAM, insomuch that everyday tasks are twice as responsive. Intel Optane Memory does not replace DRAM entirely but rather it complements it, by having both your computer is able to access programs and data much faster providing you additional responsiveness that is not delivered by DRAM alone. Let's look at a few other types of systems compared to a computer with only a hard disk drive , Intel Optane memory gives you the extra power to boot, access storage, launch, and get things done at a maximum speed. To get the most out of dual drive systems and HDD coupled with an SSD , having Intel Optane memory will provide SSD- like responsiveness on an accelerated HDD data drive automatically accessing frequently used files and applications To check if your computer model is compatible with the Intel Optane memory go to the Dell website Dell.com slash support and enter your service tag. In the Dell product page select manual and documents and check out the Setup Guide for your PC. Once in the manual, press Ctrl-F and search for Optane. Look for any info related and if you find some, read up on it to be sure your PC is compatible with Intel Optane. Whenever you need help or have questions, you can always reach out to us through social media on Facebook or Twitter or join in a chat on the Dell Community Forum. Be sure to check out our other videos on this channel and if you liked this video give it a Like and don't forget to subscribe. Thanks for watching!

It also gives practical guidance on checking device compatibility through Dell support and reviewing setup documentation. The subscription request and displayed social-media handles are ordinary channel-support engagement, not conditions for a financial, credential, or other deceptive offer.
